description: Source file implementing plugin management, dynamic node handling, and object/leaf manipulation functions within a DMAPI framework, including plugin loading and memory cleanup.

methods.name: void free_all_dynamic_nodes(DMOBJ * entryobj)
methods.description: Recursively frees all dynamic nodes and associated memory within an entry object.

methods.name: int plugin_obj_match(const char * in_param,struct dmnode * node)
methods.description: Checks if a node matches a given parameter string based on current object string.

methods.name: void dm_check_dynamic_obj(struct list_head * mem_list,DMNODE * parent_node,DMOBJ * entryobj,const char * full_obj,DMOBJ ** root_entry)
methods.description: Checks and locates dynamic objects matching a full object path within a parent node.

methods.name: void dm_check_dynamic_obj_entry(struct list_head * mem_list,DMNODE * parent_node,DMOBJ * entryobj,const char * parent_obj,const char * full_obj,DMOBJ ** root_entry)
methods.description: Checks and processes each dynamic object entry, updating the root entry if matched.

methods.name: DMOBJ * find_entry_obj(DMOBJ * entryobj,const char * obj_path)
methods.description: Finds and returns a specific entry object matching a given object path.

methods.name: void disable_entry_obj(DMOBJ * entryobj,const char * obj_path,const char * parent_obj,const char * plugin_path)
methods.description: Disables (excludes) an object from the core tree based on object path.

methods.name: void disable_entry_leaf(DMOBJ * entryobj,const char * leaf_path,const char * parent_obj,const char * plugin_path)
methods.description: Disables (excludes) a leaf parameter based on its path.

methods.name: int get_entry_obj_idx(DMOBJ * entryobj)
methods.description: Returns the index of an entry object in a list.

methods.name: int get_entry_leaf_idx(DMLEAF * entryleaf)
methods.description: Returns the index of an entry leaf in a list.

methods.name: int get_obj_idx(DMOBJ ** entryobj)
methods.description: Returns the index of a list of entry objects.

methods.name: int get_leaf_idx(DMLEAF ** entryleaf)
methods.description: Returns the index of a list of entry leaves.

methods.name: void load_plugins(DMOBJ * dm_entryobj,const char * plugin_path)
methods.description: Loads plugin files from specified directory, including JSON and shared object plugins.

methods.name: void free_plugins(DMOBJ * dm_entryobj)
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated plugin-related resources.
